headline: Belrise Industries recommends final dividend of ₹0.55 per share (11%) for FY2026
sum: Belrise Industries announced a final dividend of ₹0.55 per equity share (11% payout) for FY2026 on QIP-issued shares, subject to shareholder approval at the ensuing Annual General Meeting.
implication: QIP-issued shares now carry dividend eligibility pari passu with original equity; the dividend recommendation signals dividend policy consistency post-capital raise and requires tracking of AGM approval and ex-date declarations for cum-dividend trading windows.
detail: Belrise Industries Limited informed the NSE of its Board's recommendation of a final dividend at ₹0.55 per equity share, representing an 11% payout on the par value of equity shares issued and allotted under the Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP). The dividend is conditional on approval by members at the forthcoming Annual General Meeting. This announcement is made via the company's mandatory exchange disclosure under Listing Rules Clause 41 (corporate governance), confirming dividend eligibility on newly-issued QIP capital.

framework.ref: SEBI Listing Regulations 2015, Regulation 42 (Takeover Regulations) & Schedule III (Disclosure of Material Events)
framework.note: Mandates timely disclosure of dividend recommendations and AGM agendas to exchanges; dividend on QIP shares must be announced within statutory deadlines.
Central: dividend distribution out of profits; must comply with DPT norms and cannot exceed 10% of paid-up capital unless exempted under Schedule VI.

framework.ref: Companies Act 2013, Section 123(5) (Preferential Treatment of Shares)
framework.note: QIP-issued shares rank pari passu with existing equity in dividend eligibility unless specifically exempted by terms of issue.

framework.ref: SEBI Master Circular on Qualified Institutional Placements (QIP) 2018
framework.note: Governs issuance and listing of QIP shares; confirms that dividend eligibility commences from date of allotment unless restricted by Board resolution.

framework.ref: Income Tax Act 1961, Section 115-O (Dividend Distribution Tax — now repealed; dividend now taxed in hands of recipient)
framework.note: Amended FY 2020: dividend now subject to TDS/income tax in shareholder hands, not at company level.

framework.ref: BSE/NSE Listing Rules, Clause 41 (Corporate Governance — Dividend Policy)
framework.note: Amended 2018: listed companies must adopt and disclose dividend policy; dividend recommendations must be flagged in BSE/NSE announcements.

framework.ref: Belrise Industries Limited Articles of Association / Board Resolution
framework.note: Company-specific: dividend policy and QIP terms; determines whether dividend applies equally to all equity share classes post-QIP.

structure.consideration: Final dividend of ₹0.55 per equity share (~11% on par)
conditions: Approval by shareholders at forthcoming Annual General Meeting (AGM)
Compliance with Section 123, Companies Act 2013 (distributable profits test)
No restriction in QIP terms prohibiting dividend eligibility on newly-issued shares
approvals: Stock exchange(s) listing rule compliance (NSE/BSE disclosure completed)
structure.novel: Application of dividend parity to QIP-issued shares without carved-out restrictions; signals no preferential/differential dividend treatment post-capital raise.

triggers.law: SEBI Listing Regulations 2015, Regulation 42 (Material Events Disclosure)
triggers.note: Dividend recommendations are Tier 1 events and must be disclosed to exchanges before market opening on the following day.
Dividend may only be paid from profits or reserves; board must certify availability of distributable surplus.

triggers.law: SEBI Master Circular on QIP, Section 5 (Listing and Trading)
triggers.note: QIP shares must be credited to demat accounts and listed within required timelines; dividend eligibility date determined from allotment date.
